This hilarious event will include a regular handpicked lineup of experienced comedians, as well as a special twist. *This event is in English and suitable for ages 17+.* **WHAT'S SPECIAL ABOUT THIS SHOW?** In this final show of the season, we want to celebrate our comedy community in a fun way. Come have a drink and see what it's all about.
